translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Jesus e Aecchipwa Erhai Mwaaen
Igiwe Jesus a ittiw me wooan rhug we, re towunap aeremas kka re tapwetiw mwirin.
Iwe, erhai mwaaen eweri kaenepaai a itto reen Jesus, a foatotiw me mmwan nge a aengaeni pwe, “Menap, aere wo mwerhaen, wa aecchipwanoa aaei semwaai.”
Jesus e angenoa nge a geotteopa mwaaen we, nge a paniuwaeni pwe, “Ngaang i mwerhaen, wone cchipw noa!” Reen rhag oatowe nge a cchipw noa miniwe semwaaiun mwaaen we.

Iwe Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Pipiiy, wosoapw aengaeni mwo nge erhai minneei, nge wa faaeraeg uwen noa reen patere pwe epwe weriug. Iwe nge a feeori oasoar we Moses e akkiuneo, pwe epwe pwaeri ngaeniir aeremas pwe wa nimegacch noa.”
Jesus a Aecchipwa Erhai Rhooan Engaang Naiun Sonotaw we
Oatowe Jesus a toonong noan Capernaum, erhai soamwoonin sonotawaen Rome a itto nge a tingoar maaw ngaeni,
iwe a iura pwe, “Soamwoon, naeyi rhooan engaang a no rhag nee iimw, ese mmwenen mwagiut, nge a pwan igin metaeg.”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Ipwe noa pwe ipwe noa aecchipwa.”

Nge soamwoonin sonotaw we a aengaeni pwe, “Soamwoon, ngaang soapw erhai man yor ipitan reen oamw wopwe itto noan imwaei. Nge wopwe aepesa rhag epat kkepas, nge rhooan engaang we naeyi epwe mamaaw tae.

Ngaang mwo nge pwan ngaang erhai mwaaen ino faaen nemaeniaen erhai e soamwoon saengiaei, nge epwan yor sonotaw kka reno faaen nemaeniaei. Ipwe aengaeni inaan pwe, ‘Wopwe noa,’ iwe a noa; iya aengaeni inaan pwe, ‘Wopwe itto,’ iwe a itto; iwe iya aengaeni rhooan akkiuneo, ‘Feeori minneen,’ iwe a feeori.”

Igiwe Jesus a rongorong kkepas kkeei, a riutae reen nge a aengaeniir aeremas kkewe rettapw noa mwirin pwe, “Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi, ise giuneei mwo nge erhai me noan Israel epwe ieei wusun aan niugiuniug.
Ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe re towunap aeremas repwe itto saengi eotiw me netow nge repwe mooat oaron Abraham, Isaac me Jacob noan gupwunnap na noan Mweoiu Naaeng.
Nge rhooawe repwe no noan Mweoiu Naaeng repwe oatorawow noan rorhappiung, iga repwe sessaeng nge akkaarengi me ee.”
Iwe Jesus a aengaeni soamwoonin sonotaw we pwe, “Sefaaen noa noan imwoamw; meeta wa niugiuniug ngaeni, epwe pwan wen ngaeniug.” Iwe rhag nge rhooan engaang we naiun a mamaaw tae.
Jesus a Aecchipwa Towunepaen Aeremas
Iwe, Jesus a noa reen imwaen Peter. A noa giuneei niewe inaen pwiuniuwaen Peter ewon noan gien pwe a igin pwerhikkar ginin.
Jesus a geotteopa rhag paiun, nge esaer noa pwerhin niewe. Mwirin niewe a rhimwitae a ittae engaang ngaeni.

Igiwe a nee oatofaaef noa, aeremas ra pwigiir to reen Jesus pwuwaen aeremas kkewe eyor aniu aenneew wooar. Jesus a asiiur wow aniu aenneew reen petenaen mwaenian, nge a aemaemaewaar tae rhooawe re semwaai.
A feeori minneen pwe epwe pwaeritae miniwe profeta we Isaiah a aepesa pwe, “Iiy e arhiuwa aarh semwaai nge aiuferanoa mesemesaen aarh semwaai.”
Rhooan Mwerhaen Tapweei Mwirin Jesus
Igiwe Jesus a giuneei pwuwaen aeremas kkewe me oaron, a aengaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe repwe fatiun noa epeig meoneoiniun we.
Iwe, erhai sinsein anniug a itto reen nge a aengaeni pwe, “Sinsei, ese tiwegin iga wopwe noa ee nge ngaang ipwe tapweog.”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Fox eyor ngeteer, man aeniaen eyor feseer, iwe nge mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas esooar eew pwiuneoi ne epwe noa wonotiw aseoseo ee.”
Nge erhai mwaaen pwan iiy rhooan kkayeo a aengaeni pwe, “Soamwoon, mmwaen fang mwo ngaang ipwe sefaaen noa nipwaeni noa mwaaen na semaei.”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Itto tapweaei nge wa nigitiir rhooa mae repwe sipegin nipwaeni aar mae.”
Jesus a Oapoassaetiw Eew Aaeng Cchoaw
Jesus a teeotae wooan pwoot we nge rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra tapweei.
Ese mmwaei mwo nge eew mwoor enoa itto noan meoneoiniun we, nge pwoot we a arapakkaan aan epwene mweoiusiutiw. Nge Jesus e maiur.
Rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra noa reen, nge ra faingitae. Ra aengaeni pwe, “Soamwoon, aemenewaegemaem pwe sipwene mae!”
Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Meeta oawwa mesag reen? Me gaen mwittiginen aaemi niugiuniug!” Iwe a iutae nge a kkepas sseor ngaeni aaeng me noa pwe repwe poas noa, iwe rhag nge a niuwanoa wooai saaet.
Iwe, mwaaen kkewe ra riutae nge ra aepesa pwe, “Meeta taeppen aeremas een? Iye aaeng mwo me noa nge re tapweei mwaenian!”
Jesus a Aecchipwaar Riiurhai Mwaaen Eyor Aniu Aenneew Wooar

Igiwe Jesus a toori faniuwaen Gadara eno epeig meoneoiniun we, a itto rhuungiir riiurhai mwaaen retowow me noan paeyi kkewe. Mwaaen kkeei nge ewartae aniu aenneew wooar, nge re igin aemmesag ina minne esooar ne e rhiuwen taeri aan een reen.
Reen rhag oaton een nge ra aekkepwastae pwe, “Naiun Deus, meeta minne wo tipaeni me remaem? Wa itto pwe wopwe itto aeppaetigimaem mmwaen oaton apwiung?”
Eno eew cchon sino re mwommwongo fetaen me peiginoar.
Iwe aniu aenneew kkewe ra aeffaenipirhe ngaeni Jesus pwe, “Aere wopwe asiugemaem, fangenoa aemaem neeiir sino kenaan.”

Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Oawnoa!” Iwe ra toowow me wooar mwaaen kkewe nge ra noa wartae wooar sino kkewe. Iwe cchon sino kkewe ra fattapw tiw wenepeigin rhug we e ittiw noan meoneoiniun we ittiw moapw noa.
Mwaaen kkewe rhooan ffooanon sino ra fattapw noa ra ittiw nee aepinoamw, iwe ra ittiw fioangei oanongan meeta kkewe a wen ngaeniir mwaaen kkewe ewartae aniu aenneew wooar.
Iwe oanongeer rhooan aepinoamw we ra noa pwe repwe noa rhuungi Jesus. Nge igiwe ra weri, ra aeffaenipirhe ngaeni pwe epwe siusaengi miniwe faniuweer.
